query: INSERT INTO workspace_configs (workspace_id, org_id, settings_json, secrets_enc, secret_keys, updated_by, updated_at) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, now()) ON CONFLICT (workspace_id) DO UPDATE SET settings_json = EXCLUDED.settings_json, secrets_enc = EXCLUDED.secrets_enc, secret_keys = EXCLUDED.secret_keys, updated_by = EXCLUDED.updated_by, updated_at = now()
